mapper.insert: insert into tb_admin( id, username, password_hash, nickname, avatar, status, school, last_login_ip, last_login_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( null, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{status}, #{school}, #{lastLoginIp}, #{lastLoginTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: select * from tb_admin where username = #{username} AND password_hash = #{passwordHash} AND deleted = 0
